OPENCTI_URL.description: The base URL of the OpenCTI instance.

OPENCTI_TOKEN.description: The API token to connect to OpenCTI.

CONNECTOR_SCOPE.description: The scope of the connector, i.e. the observable types it can enrich.

CONNECTOR_LOG_LEVEL.description: The minimum level of logs to display.

CONNECTOR_AUTO.description: Whether the connector should run automatically when an entity is created or updated.

OSINT_INDUSTRIES_API_KEY.description: The API key used to authenticate against the OSINT Industries API.

OSINT_INDUSTRIES_BASE_URL.description: The base URL of the OSINT Industries API.

OSINT_INDUSTRIES_TLP_LEVEL.description: The TLP marking applied to the objects produced by the connector.

OSINT_INDUSTRIES_PREMIUM.description: Whether to query the premium modules. Enabling it returns more results but consumes more API credits.
